c1_context.description: Directory platform for discovering and verifying Black-owned businesses: Next.js web front-end plus a Rust scraping/ETL workspace, with Postgres, ClickHouse, NATS, Valkey, and MinIO backing services.

people.name: Business Owner
people.description: Registers and manages their Black business profile

people.name: Admin
people.description: Moderates listings and manages the directory

people.name: Directory Visitor
people.description: Browses the public directory and business detail pages

external_systems.name: SearXNG
external_systems.description: Metasearch API used for business and location discovery

external_systems.name: Nominatim
external_systems.description: OpenStreetMap geocoding API used to resolve business locations

containers.name: black-owned-frontend
containers.description: Next.js full-stack web app: React UI for directory, owner, admin and analytics; REST route handlers and a hand-rolled GraphQL endpoint; direct Postgres access, Valkey cache, NATS WebSocket chat, MinIO uploads

containers.name: bw-types
containers.description: Shared Rust domain types: Business, Review, User, Verification, Message, Event and email payload structs

containers.name: bw_scraper
containers.description: Active Rust service: SearXNG discovery, website enrichment, geocoding; imports to Postgres and ClickHouse; operator API on :8080; publishes NATS email events

containers.name: bw-ingestion
containers.description: Dormant Rust ETL library crate: NATS consumers (email, chat, image), Valkey cache service and invalidation, source-specific ETL (Google Maps, Yelp, Facebook); no binary target

containers.name: bw-api
containers.description: Rust GraphQL API (axum + async-graphql) that does not currently compile (task #71); excluded from CI coverage

containers.name: postgres
containers.description: Primary relational store: businesses, locations, users, scrape jobs, pending imports

containers.name: clickhouse
containers.description: Analytics store for enriched business rows and scraping snapshots

containers.name: nats
containers.description: Event bus: email, chat, image-processing and cache-invalidation subjects

containers.name: minio
containers.description: S3-compatible object storage for business logos and images

containers.name: valkey
containers.description: In-memory cache: directory query cache and refresh tokens

components.name: React Pages
components.description: App Router UI: directory, business detail, owner, admin, analytics

components.name: REST API Routes
components.description: Route handlers under src/app/api: directory, businesses, auth, admin, analytics

components.name: GraphQL Endpoint
components.description: Hand-rolled regex-parsed GraphQL endpoint over business-schema resolvers

components.name: JWT Auth
components.description: RS256 JWT auth-service, role-gated createAuthMiddleware, bcrypt password hashing

components.name: Data Layer
components.description: Postgres repositories (user, business, scraped-business, chat, ...) with lazy getPool() singleton and Valkey query cache

components.name: Chat Service
components.description: NATS WebSocket chat: browser client plus server-side publish/subscribe helpers

components.name: Object Storage
components.description: MinIO presigned URLs for business logo and image uploads
